answer: Fresh-task bond: each epoch the board draws a task from the oasis pool and mirrors it on a public ledger. An identity locks 70 credits, does the task, and files stamped proof; auditors check it against the mirror copy. A replayed proof falls into the canyon between task and stamp and fails. The kth fake still needs a kth task plus 70 credits, so 1,000 fakes cost 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 70 once and keeps its full share.
